SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Brice.en: BRICE: The nurse says we'll walk\nagain by tomorrow.\pI'm going back to the mountains.\nMaybe there I'll think of a plan.
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Brice.fr: BRICE : L'infirmière dit qu'on\nremarchera demain.\pJe retourne dans les montagnes.\nJ'y trouverai peut-être un plan.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Flora.en: FLORA: He wants all ten stones.\nThat is what the MASTER said.\pYou carry more of them than he\ndoes. Keep them close.
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Flora.fr: FLORA : Il veut les dix pierres.\nC'est ce qu'a dit le MAÎTRE.\pTu en portes plus que lui.\nGarde-les près de toi.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatI.en: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ONYBRIS?
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatI.fr: Soupir…\nCe serait pas génial ?\pSi le CONSEIL 4 venait\nécraser la TEAM ONYBRIS ?

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Growth.en: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Growth.fr: Les POKéMON grandissent\ndifféremment selon les espèces.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_N.en: N: They say two travelers are\nalready near the volcano.\pOld friends of the road. Meet\nthem. Learn from them.
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_N.fr: N : On dit que deux voyageurs sont\ndéjà près du volcan.\pDe vieux amis de la route.\nRencontre-les. Apprends d'eux.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphC.en: HEMATEK is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ONYBRIS.
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphC.fr: HEMATEK est connue de tous.\pElle est victime de sa propre\ncélébrité : elle a attiré la TEAM\lONYBRIS.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRo.en: TEAM ONYBRIS took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!
SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRo.fr: La TEAM ONYBRIS a décollé ! On peut\nsortir en sécurité à nouveau !\pC'est super !
